jobs.title: Content & Social Contractor, FloElite
jobs.description: FloSports is a world-class sports media company strategically positioned to be the essential destination for passionate sports fans, delighting them with live event coverage, breaking news, highlights, stats, rankings, and team and player profiles. We are growing Our Sports every day by continuing to invest in our ever-expanding ecosystem, which consists of over a dozen sport verticals and hundreds of streaming partners. FloSports is creating the home for college conferences/leagues and sports like grappling, hockey, track & field, racing, cheer, wrestling, and more, and we are looking for innovative and passionate people like you to help us! THE ROLE: FloSports is looking for a Content & Social Contractor to support FloElite, our destination for CrossFit and functional fitness competition. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who deeply understands the CrossFit community and knows how to turn live competitions, athletes and storylines into compelling social content that grows our audience and drives fans to watch on FloElite. You’ll be the primary person responsible for FloElite’s social presence, including ideating, creating and publishing content around live events and maintaining an active, relevant presence between competitions. Because FloElite’s live event calendar is more concentrated than some of our other sports, this role requires someone who can find creative ways to keep the audience engaged even when there is not an event happening every weekend. Someone with great taste, a head full of ideas and the skills to bring them to life. Someone who's just as comfortable behind the camera as they are in front of it, and has the personality to make people want to watch. And the best part? You'll be creating content for people just like you. A little about us. At Envato, we're all about helping creative professionals do their best work. We're an all-in-one creative asset toolkit bringing together world-class stock assets, purpose-built AI tools for creatives need to bring their ideas to life. Our world is full of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who love what they do. People who are always looking for the next tool, technique or idea to make their work better. That's who you'll be talking to. Your people. What's the gig? You'll be one of the faces of Envato, concepting, making and starring in content that brings our products to life. Think clever product demos, creative experiments, social videos, tutorials that don't feel like tutorials and content that makes other creatives think,”I need that in my toolkit”. You'll own the whole creative process, from the first idea to the final edit. Writing, filming, presenting, editing and using the latest creative tools, including AI. jobs.title: Social Content Manager
jobs.description: Bei Jellyfish glauben wir an die Kraft vielfältiger Perspektiven und an eine inklusive Zusammenarbeit. Wir begrüßen Menschen, die in diversen, kollaborativen Teams über sich hinauswachsen und die individuellen Sichtweisen anderer schätzen. Jellyfish ist eine globale Digital Marketing Agentur – eine einzigartige Verbindung aus Tech-Enthusiast:innen, kreativen Köpfen sowie Media- und Daten-Expert:innen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel vereint: unsere Kund:innen auf ihrer digitalen Reise weiterzubringen. Unser Anspruch, unterschiedliche Blickwinkel aktiv einzubinden, ist der Treibstoff für unsere innovativen Lösungen und Strategien. Wir hinterfragen den Status quo, denken Media-Aktivierung neu und entwickeln Stories mit Wirkkraft, für unsere internationalen Kund:innen und deren Zielgruppen. Gestalte mit uns eine Zukunft, in der berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Hand in Hand gehen. Stellenbeschreibung Du berichtest direkt an den Senior Social Content Manager und sorgst vom ersten Tag an für spürbaren Impact in unserer paneuropäischen Social-Creative-Abteilung. Wir sind stolz auf unsere langjährigen Partnerschaften mit globalen Entertainment-Größen und auf unsere Arbeit, die Kultur prägt und sich von der Masse abhebt. Von unserem Berliner Hub aus – mit echter hybrider Flexibilität – treibst du Social-First-Storytelling und kulturelle Relevanz für eine führende Streaming-Marke auf dem deutschen Markt voran. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem agilen Netzwerk aus Editor:innen, Designer:innen und Integrated Producer:innen in Berlin, London, Paris und Madrid steuerst du alles – von dynamischen Vertical Videos (TikTok und Instagram) über Creator-Kooperationen bis hin zur Live-Begleitung von Events vor Ort. Mit echtem kreativen Gestaltungsspielraum und einer offenen, kollegialen Unternehmenskultur bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem mutige Ideen wachsen können.
